newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 7.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - State and private banks raise prime lending and time deposit interest rates
Korean airliner crashes in Guam, at least 28 survive
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Foreign minister John Chang said to be appointed vice premier
LIBERTY TIMES - Two armed gangsters detain seven Mercury Tigers baseball players over lost games, then release them
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Investigation Bureau to avoid questioning stock market investors or listed company owners during trading hours to reduce impact on local bourse
Central bank mulls releasing funds to ease tightening liquidity

ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Finance ministry to submit draft regulations on opening of industrial banks to cabinet for approval; China Development Investment Co expected to be first to become industrial bank
Bank of Taiwan, Cooperative Bank of Taiwan raise lending and time deposit interest rates
